core_differentiators: Expert Manual Therapy & Dorn Spinal Therapy
business_profile.introduction: Rajan's Physiotherapy and Pain Relief Centre is a dedicated physiotherapy and rehabilitation centre committed to delivering professional, evidence-informed, and patient-centred care. Established in 2009, the centre focuses on pain management, functional rehabilitation, mobility restoration, and improving patients' overall quality of life. Led by Dr. Prabhu Rajan PT, (MIAP L-27944), a senior physiotherapist with 17 years of experience specializing in sports and musculoskeletal rehabilitation, the centre provides individualised treatment plans tailored to each patient's condition, functional limitations, and rehabilitation goals.

services_and_treatments.name: Orthopedic & Sports Manual Therapy
services_and_treatments.description: Hands-on specialized mobilization, chiropractic adjustments, and joint manipulation to relieve stiffness, restore joint mechanics, and accelerate return to athletics and daily activities.

services_and_treatments.name: Dorn Method Spinal Alignment
services_and_treatments.description: A gentle, non-invasive vertebrae alignment technique without cracking or surgery, targeting spinal subluxations, disc compression, sciatica, neck ache, and scoliosis.

services_and_treatments.name: Advanced Laser & Scanning Laser Therapy
services_and_treatments.description: High-intensity therapeutic laser that penetrates deep soft tissues to reduce acute/chronic inflammation, stimulate ATP cellular repair, and relieve deep tendon and ligament pain.

services_and_treatments.name: Radial Extracorporeal Shockwave Therapy (ESWT)
services_and_treatments.description: Non-invasive acoustic wave therapy specifically effective for chronic calcifications, heel spurs, plantar fasciitis, tennis elbow, and stubborn tendinopathies.

services_and_treatments.name: TECAR Therapy (Radiofrequency)
services_and_treatments.description: Radiofrequency-based deep diathermy treatment that increases microcirculation, relaxes intense muscle spasms, and accelerates cellular healing.

services_and_treatments.name: Clinical Dry Needling (CDNT - USA)
services_and_treatments.description: Precision filament needle insertion into taut neuromuscular trigger points to instantly eliminate deep muscular knots, spasm, and referred nerve pain.

services_and_treatments.name: Kinesio Cupping Therapy & IASTM
services_and_treatments.description: Dynamic negative-pressure cupping and Instrument-Assisted Soft Tissue Mobilization to break up scar tissue, release fascial restrictions, and enhance lymph drainage.

services_and_treatments.name: Acupuncture & Acupressure (University of Colombo D.Ac)
services_and_treatments.description: Holistic meridian and electro-acupuncture for holistic neuromuscular balance, neuropathic pain management, and systemic relief.

services_and_treatments.name: Electrotherapy Modalities
services_and_treatments.description: Comprehensive clinical modalities including Interferential Therapy (IFT), Ultrasonic Therapy (UST), Electrical Muscle Stimulation (EMS), Shortwave Diathermy (SWD), and Cryotherapy.

services_and_treatments.name: Kinesio Taping (CKT)
services_and_treatments.description: Functional neuromuscular taping to support weak joints, decrease swelling, improve proprioception, and protect muscles during rehabilitation.

services_and_treatments.name: Varma Therapy
services_and_treatments.description: Traditional Indian vital point therapy practiced for neurological, neuromuscular, and chronic pain alleviation.

services_and_treatments.name: Home Physiotherapy Visits
services_and_treatments.description: Personalized home rehabilitation visits for post-operative, elderly, or severely immobile patients unable to travel to the clinic.

patient_testimonials.condition: Severe Knee Pain, Old Ligament Tear & Stair Climbing Disability
patient_testimonials.review: When I met the Doctor, I was not able to walk properly and while sitting too had severe pain. I fell down years back and had a ligament tear in my knee which I didn't operate. I met Doctor with very little hope, but he never asked me to take x-rays or scans. Just by touching he found out the problem. During the second sitting, I found enormous improvement. He has magic in his fingers—he does trigger release for muscle pain in seconds. Now I am able to climb stairs normally, which I couldn't do for 10 long years. It was an emotional moment for me and my daughter. I strongly believe God sent an angel in the form of Dr. Prabhu Rajan.

patient_testimonials.condition: 15-Year Chronic L3-L4 Disc Bulge & Cervical Spondylitis
patient_testimonials.review: Dr. Prabhu is experienced in handling pain arising out of cervical & lumbar spondylitis or disc bulge and sports injuries. By identifying the underlying problem behind the pain, he explains the issue in layman's language and recommends treatment—dorn/manual therapy along with relevant exercises. I have been living with pain for 15 years, consulted orthos, tried ayurveda, but within the first 10 sessions and basic exercises, my pain subsided completely without any medicines! I highly recommend Dr. Prabhu to anyone suffering from chronic pain before deciding to wear neck collars or back belts.

When I first met Dr. Prabhu, he made me completely comfortable in explaining my condition and history. He created a calm, reassuring environment and is professional to the core. He takes immense personal care during treatment, instructs his team clearly, and stays highly interactive so patients feel genuinely cared for. Highly recommended!

I consulted Dr. Prabhu when I had persistent knee pain. He listened patiently, analyzed the issue to find the root cause, and never scared me with technical jargon. He taught targeted knee strengthening exercises that solved the problem permanently. I am deeply thankful that I have not experienced any recurrence of knee pain since!
